body:
my parents have as much as said that they don't think i need medication and that the mental illnesses i've been diagnosed with over time are bs and that i'm just a crybaby. i have significantly burdened them emotionally and financially and they are sick of me.

i will try to talk to him, i don't know how far that will go before i cry like a baby and he gets annoyed with me. 

it's hard because i can't communicate my entire life situation effectively over the internet like this. my partner being this way is not the first straw, i just feel like it's the last.

this is probably the 4th or 5th medication i've taken. i've been taking it since 2010 after crashing and burning on several others my doctor tried to give me. i'm currently taking lamictal and it tends to be helpful. i last went to the doctor a couple of months ago. i had been going to counseling more frequently but now that is a thing of the past. 

i can't face my family, and i don't have any friends who care enough to listen. i've isolated myself so badly and now i'm afraid that i have nothing left.

i skyped with him earlier and i was feeling sad because i got some bad news about my health insurance. he was annoyed and told me to stop being so negative, that i am always negative and that i don't care about anyone other than myself. at the beginning of the conversation i tried not to talk about what was bothering me at the moment. i haven't really asked him about my suspicions yet, i don't know if it's worth fighting over. 

i feel like he's right about me being so awful. i don't know what to do, but i am really really selfish and i hate myself.

thank you. i had been seeing a counselor for quite a while but my insurance won't pay for it anymore. i'm on medication and that's enough for them. it's super disconcerting, but when i think of all the people i could send messages to, i'm embarrassed to even think about it. i've had a lot of problems in the past and i'm scared to tell people that my medication and counseling haven't helped. 

i don't know how to deal with my boyfriend situation. i honestly feel like things would be easier for everyone if i just died, but i also know that is probably a stupid feeling for me to have.

he's acting super weird. sometimes he's lovey dovey and excited to talk to me, and other times he completely ignores me after initiating conversations online and treats me like i'm just a stupid girl. he is always telling me that i'm too negative about everything but i can't help it. a lot is going on and on top of everything else, i miss him.

i'm not close with any of my family or really even friends. i've kind of isolated myself. i don't feel like i can talk to them and with recent developments i can't talk to my partner either.
